plugin.name: Koola10 Synth
plugin.render_notes: Standard VST3 stereo audio out. No proprietary or wrapped formats are produced.

parameters.name: Wavetable Position
parameters.description: Morphs between the frames of the loaded wavetable. 0 is the first frame, 1 is the last.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Cutoff frequency of the post-oscillator low-pass filter (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter).

parameters.name: Filter Resonance
parameters.description: Emphasis around the cutoff frequency. 0.707 is neutral in JUCE terms; higher values ring and self-oscillate.

parameters.name: Amp Attack
parameters.description: Time taken to reach full level after a note starts.

parameters.name: Amp Decay
parameters.description: Time taken to fall from full level to the sustain level.

parameters.name: Amp Sustain
parameters.description: Held level while a note is held down, after attack and decay have finished.

parameters.name: Amp Release
parameters.description: Time taken to fade to silence after the key is released.

parameters.name: Master Level
parameters.description: Final output level applied after the amplifier envelope.

non_automatable_state.name: Wavetable File
non_automatable_state.description: Absolute path of the loaded .wav wavetable, stored in the plugin state so a session recalls the same table.
